name: Asana
description: Asana is a work management platform whose developer documentation describes a REST API with personal access tokens, service accounts and OAuth.
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Candidate families were enumerated from the Asana developer documentation pages recorded as the seven sources cited in its families' contracts (authentication, personal-access-token, oauth, webhooks, app-components, oauth-scopes and faq pages), read on 2026-10-04; the list is what those pages name, not a complete inventory. Asana states its API tokens are opaque and may change format, so no candidate has a researched format.
